purpose: Human-written queries with human-decided expectations. Every other check in this repo uses a record's own vector as the query, which measures self-retrieval, not search. This is the only test that asks what a person would type.
how_expectations_were_set: Chris graded each question for realism (A/B/C) without seeing an expected answer. Expectations were then set by reading the records the catalog actually holds, and the debatable ones were decided by Chris.

written_against.fingerprint_of: lib/gold.ts datasetFingerprint(), over the post-enrichment dataset
